rule: majority of 4; on a 2-2 tie the majority of the 3 Opus judges decides; a major counts when 2 of 4 raise the same problem
prompt:
You are a blind reviewer of 16px pixel-art game tiles for a SNES-style JRPG (3/4 top-down view). Do not read any code or other files; judge only the PNG boards listed below (open each with the Read tool; crop/zoom with python PIL into /tmp if you need detail). Each board shows: a reference from the existing game ("Beodeul", the quality bar) at 1x and 3x, then two candidates X and Y, each as the piece at 1x and 3x (checkerboard = transparent) and in a small scene with a 16x24 character for scale.

Criteria for each candidate:
(1) reads correctly in 3/4 top-down at 1x (top surfaces seen from above, front faces full height, no oblique/side view, no flat front elevation)
(2) looks like it belongs to the same game as the Beodeul reference (palette, shading, texture density, outline, pixel density, scale vs the character)
(3) joins are seamless (rails/carpet/decals line up, no visible 16px repeat, no broken edges)
(4) reads as its stated purpose and theme (title line on each board)

A "major" is a defect that would make you reject the piece for the game; a "minor" is polish. Be adversarial and concrete (say where in the picture).

- /home/main/z-project/rpg-zzu-dt-earth/qa-runs/dungeon-themes/panel/r2/armor_stand.png

- /home/main/z-project/rpg-zzu-dt-earth/qa-runs/dungeon-themes/panel/r2/ore_vein.png

- /home/main/z-project/rpg-zzu-dt-earth/qa-runs/dungeon-themes/panel/r2/tomb_slab.png
